verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack describes New Relic offering a choice of data storage region/residency; docs focus on agents, NRQL, dashboards, alerts, and MCP integration but never mention data residency controls. Community comments (e.g., trans-oceanic latency for non-US users) even hint at data being centralized rather than user-selectable by region, but this doesn't rise to a documented contradiction of a claimed feature—there's simply no claim to dispute.
